notes.title: Abandoned
notes.notes:
Hi.
It's Me
WARRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRR

Well, I’ve decided to give up this game.
I can give a thousand reasons explaining the reasons for abandonment, but I can summarize it in: I have no money ːsteamhappyː

My game began as an ambition to retrace the beautiful memories of enjoying a game without monetization, without dlcs, with friends, enjoy the apocalypse and endless things more. It is a failure, I remade the game about three times, I invested several times my savings to improve it, time of my life that I will not recover and the disgust of knowing that I will not be able to do it alone ( Quite OBVIOUS ) Simply my past self wanted to do it and without any budget, is what I set

I don’t want to give up and be able to fulfill some of my childhood dreams, a game created by me.

But hey, I just want **** ***

notes.title: Deborg Desolation VR;006
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! 
I am pleased to announce this version with multiplayer (Testing). It’s not a big deal, but I put all the effort into it, the new thing is:
*) Trailer with cinematic and gamplay
*) Added sound effects
*) New Guns
*) New Main Menu
*) New Intro
*) New Models
*) Being able to play with friends
*) More Lives
*) Loading Screen
*) Die much more
In short, several added things that I execute little by little, I know that there will be many mistakes and improvements to make, but I trust that I can achieve it
And well, thank you for getting here
Greetings and see you at: Deborg Desolation!
